claims.claim: The Treaty of Wuchale was signed on May 2, 1889, at Wuchale, Ethiopia.
claims.verbatim: Treaty of Wuchale was signed May 2, 1889 at Wuchale, Ethiopia
claims.source: Treaty text itself (Tier 1) — available at Horn Affairs and Afrolegends PDF
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Treaty of Wuchale was signed May 2, 1889 at Wuchale, Ethiopia

claims.claim: The Treaty of Wuchale contained 20 articles, each rendered in both Amharic and Italian.
claims.verbatim: Treaty contained 20 articles in both Amharic and Italian
claims.source: Treaty text (Tier 1) — Horn Affairs full English translation
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Treaty contained 20 articles in both Amharic and Italian

claims.claim: Article 17's Italian text stated the Ethiopian emperor consents to use the Italian government for all dealings with other powers, wording Italy read as creating a protectorate.
claims.verbatim: Sua Maesta il Re dei Re d'Etiopia consente di servirsi del Governo di Sua Maesta il Re d'Italia per tutte le trattazioni di affari che avesse con altre potenze o governi.
claims.source: Treaty text, Italian original available at University of Parma PDF
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Article 17 Italian version made Ethiopia an Italian protectorate; Amharic version made Italian mediation optional

claims.claim: Article 17's Amharic version stated the Ethiopian emperor can, not must, use the Italian government for dealings with other powers, making Italian mediation optional.
claims.verbatim: His Majesty the King of Kings of Ethiopia **can** use the Government of His Majesty the King of Italy for all business with other powers or governments.
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Article 17 Italian version made Ethiopia an Italian protectorate; Amharic version made Italian mediation optional

claims.claim: Count Pietro Antonelli, an Italian diplomat, personally negotiated and drafted both the Italian and Amharic versions of the treaty.
claims.verbatim: Count Pietro Antonelli negotiated and drafted both versions
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Count Pietro Antonelli negotiated and drafted both versions

claims.claim: Antonelli, born in 1853, was the grandson of Cardinal Giacomo Antonelli and made his first expedition to Ethiopia between 1879 and 1881.
claims.verbatim: Born 1853, grandson of Cardinal Giacomo Antonelli. First expedition to Ethiopia 1879-1881.
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Count Pietro Antonelli negotiated and drafted both versions

claims.claim: Antonelli's Amharic was described as lacking full proficiency, though sources agree he understood enough to know the treaty's two versions differed.
claims.verbatim: lacking full Amharic proficiency
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Antonelli knew Amharic (degree of fluency contested)

claims.claim: Italy notified the European powers in October 1889 that Ethiopia had become an Italian protectorate.
claims.verbatim: Italy notified European powers of protectorate status in October 1889
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Italy notified European powers of protectorate status in October 1889

claims.claim: In April 1891, Emperor Menelik II sent a circular letter to the heads of Britain, France, Germany, Italy, and Russia defining Ethiopia's borders and asserting its sovereignty.
claims.verbatim: Sent to Britain, France, Germany, Italy, Russia. Defined Ethiopia's borders and asserted sovereignty.
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Menelik sent circular letter to European heads of state (April 10, 1891)

claims.claim: Emperor Menelik II formally repudiated the Treaty of Wuchale in February 1893.
claims.verbatim: Menelik formally repudiated Treaty of Wuchale in February 1893
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Menelik formally repudiated Treaty of Wuchale in February 1893

claims.claim: The Battle of Adwa, a decisive Ethiopian victory over Italy, was fought on March 1, 1896.
claims.verbatim: Battle of Adwa fought March 1, 1896 — decisive Ethiopian victory
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Battle of Adwa fought March 1, 1896 — decisive Ethiopian victory

claims.claim: Ethiopian forces at Adwa are estimated at roughly 82,000 soldiers plus 20,000 spearmen and 8,000 cavalry, with other sources citing up to 100,000.
claims.verbatim: ~82,000 soldiers + 20,000 spearmen + 8,000 cavalry
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Ethiopian forces numbered 73,000-100,000+

claims.claim: Italian colonial force size at Adwa is disputed, with estimates of 14,500 or 17,000 depending on whether askari troops are counted.
claims.verbatim: Discrepancy between 14,500 and 17,000 depending on how askari are counted
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Italian forces numbered ~14,500

claims.claim: Roughly 5,900 Italian and colonial troops died at Adwa, including 300 officers, 4,600 Italian rank-and-file, and about 1,000 askari.
claims.verbatim: 300 officers, 4,600 Italian rank, ~1,000 askari = ~5,900 dead
claims.anchor: ### Claim: ~6,000 Italian/colonial troops killed, ~3,800 captured

claims.claim: Ethiopia is considered the only African nation to defeat a European colonial force in battle and keep its independence afterward.
claims.verbatim: the only African nation to defeat a European colonial force and keep its independence
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Ethiopia is the only African nation to defeat a European colonial army AND maintain independence

claims.claim: The Treaty of Addis Ababa secured Italy's full recognition of Ethiopian sovereignty and nullified the Treaty of Wuchale.
claims.verbatim: Italy's full recognition of Ethiopian sovereignty, nullification of Wuchale
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Treaty of Addis Ababa (October 1896) recognized Ethiopian sovereignty

claims.claim: Empress Taytu Betul organized logistics and devised the strategy to cut off the Italian water supply at the Battle of Mekelle.
claims.verbatim: Organized logistics, devised strategy to cut off Italian water supply at Battle of Mekelle.
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Empress Taytu Betul commanded her own contingent at Adwa

claims.claim: The Organisation of African Unity was founded on May 25, 1963, in Addis Ababa.
claims.verbatim: OAU founded May 25, 1963 in Addis Ababa
claims.anchor: ### Claim: OAU founded May 25, 1963 in Addis Ababa

claims.claim: Adwa Victory Day is observed on March 2 of the Ethiopian calendar and was first celebrated officially under Haile Selassie.
claims.verbatim: observed on March 2 (Yekatit 23 Ethiopian calendar)
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Adwa Victory Day is Ethiopia's national holiday

claims.claim: The Adwa Victory Memorial Museum, inaugurated in February 2024, drew over 31,000 visitors in its first month.
claims.verbatim: 31,000+ visitors in first month
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Adwa Victory Memorial Museum inaugurated February 2024

claims.claim: The Treaty of Wuchale's preamble asserted that its Italian and Amharic versions agreed perfectly and both carried equal legal authority.
claims.verbatim: This Treaty being written in Italian to Amharic and the two versions agreeing perfectly with each other, both texts will be considered official and will in all respects equal faith.
claims.anchor: ### Quote: Treaty preamble claims both versions agree

claims.claim: One scholarly view holds Antonelli privately accepted the Amharic reading but deliberately left the Italian version unchanged.
claims.verbatim: Antonelli knew Amharic, accepted the Amharic reading, but did not change the Italian version (Encyclopaedia Africana)
claims.anchor: ### Contested: Was Article 17 deliberately mistranslated?

claims.claim: An alternative view holds Antonelli's imperfect Amharic could have produced genuine confusion rather than deliberate fraud.
claims.verbatim: Antonelli's Amharic was imperfect — "lacking full proficiency" — genuine confusion possible
claims.anchor: ### Contested: Was Article 17 deliberately mistranslated?

claims.claim: A third view holds the protectorate clause was already in Italy's draft before Antonelli arrived, suggesting deliberate state policy rather than one diplomat's trick.
claims.verbatim: The protectorate clause was in Italy's draft before Antonelli even arrived — suggesting it was state policy, not one man's trick
claims.source: School C (Italian institutional fraud, not just Antonelli)
claims.anchor: ### Contested: Was Article 17 deliberately mistranslated?

claims.claim: One secondary source suggests the treaty's provisional draft, including the protectorate clause, was written in Italy before negotiations began.
claims.verbatim: The provisional treaty draft was presumably written in Italy before negotiations
claims.anchor: ### Claim: The provisional treaty draft was presumably written in Italy before negotiations

claims.claim: Menelik reportedly wrote to King Umberto I of Italy on September 27, 1890, protesting Italy's interpretation of Article 17.
claims.verbatim: Menelik wrote to King Umberto I protesting Italian interpretation (September 27, 1890)
claims.source: Multiple secondary sources give this date
claims.anchor: ### Claim: Menelik wrote to King Umberto I protesting Italian interpretation (September 27, 1890)
